title: Home Comfort Financing Late Fees — Relief by Account Age
content:
Home Comfort Financing grants a late-fee account-age relief by how long the account has been funded. The late-fee account-age relief is 15 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, 10 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

Account age is the number of whole months from the account's funded date to the date of handling.

| Whole months since funding | Late-fee account-age relief |
|---|---|
| 36 or more | 15 percent |
| 12 to 35 | 10 percent |
| 0 to 11 | zero |

The late-fee account-age relief is one of the late-fee reliefs that make up the late-fee relief percentage; the late-fee reliefs are added together and the scheduled late fee is reduced once by that total, never one relief after another.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical accounts)

| Funded … whole months before the date of handling | Relief |
|---|---|
| 11 | zero |
| 12 | 10 percent |
| 35 | 10 percent |
| 36 | 15 percent |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An account funded 37 whole months ago takes 15 percent. If its late-fee relief percentage were made up of that 15 percent and a further 10 percent of another late-fee relief, the total would be 25 percent, and a scheduled late fee of $25.00 would become $25.00 multiplied by 75 and divided by 100, that is $18.75, one reduction by the total.
